subject: Approval request: concierge + integration concession for Brightline pilot
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request: concierge + integration concession for Brightline pilot

Hi Ben / Marissa —

Following up from our ALS this morning. Brightline is ready to sign the 6-month pilot (target start Apr 1) but procurement is pushing back on the onboarding add-ons cost. To close the pilot this quarter we need one-time concessions:

- Include ConciergePlus (premium onboarding, 40 hrs of RM/on-call support) at no additional fee for pilot period.
- Cover up to 8 dev-hours of custom connector work (Brightline's EMR mapping) as part of the onboarding bundle.
- One-time 10% discount on the first 3 months' usage (to offset integration delay risk).

ARR impact is small (~$95k ARR expected if converted), but the pilot is a strategic reference in oncology vertical and the customer has strong procurement demands. Attachments: SOW v3, pricing summary, and a draft SLA amendment with the concierge line-item.

Ask: Exec sign-off on the above concessions (concierge inclusion + 8 dev-hours + 10% first-quarter credit). If approved, I'll send the redline to procurement and request DocuSign.

Thanks —
Sean
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0198

--
Attachment stubs: Brightline_SOW_v3.docx (proposed SOW), proseries-pricing-summary.xlsx (pricing impact), SLA-amendment_draft.pdf (language for concierge inclusion)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: concierge + integration concession for Brightline pilot

+1 on urgency. A few data points for the approvers:
- Customer exec sponsor: Eric Shaw (Head of Engineering) — strong advocate; pilot expands to three sites if KRs met.
- Procurement timeline: needs signed agreement by 3/19 to align with their board meeting.
- Risk: custom connector is low complexity (FHIR subset mapping), 8 hours should be sufficient; dev team has capacity in week-of-3/22.

If we can get sign-off with the condition that concierge is limited to pilot-only and the 8 hours are non-recurring (outlined in SOW), I think we close this week. I also recommend we add a success criteria section (KPI gates) to the SOW so there is a clean path to paid renewal.

Ben
Account Executive

On Mar 9, 2027, at 10:15 AM, Sean Gallagher wrote:
> (original message)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: concierge + integration concession for Brightline pilot

Marissa —

I can support a constrained concession but propose these guardrails:
1) ConciergePlus included for pilot only, with explicit scope (40 hrs max, named RM contacts, no escalation SLA beyond pilot).
2) Custom connector: cap at 8 dev hours; any additional work will be T&M or part of a follow-on SOW.
3) Replace the 10% usage discount with a $6k one-time onboarding credit (same economic impact but simpler to track against invoices).
4) Add a 30-day acceptance window tied to three KPIs (latency < 350ms P95 for key routes; onboarding completion checklist; two successful end-to-end test cases).

If Marissa signs off on those conditions I'll provide approval language that legal can drop into the SLA amendment.

Laura
Head of Customer Partnerships

On Tue, Mar 9, 2027 at 1:02 PM, Ben Carter wrote:
> (Ben's message)

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: concierge + integration concession for Brightline pilot

Sean / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for proposing the pilot terms. Procurement is comfortable with a limited concession if we get clarity on scope and acceptance criteria. A couple of asks from our side:
- Can you confirm that the 8 dev-hours include testing and one remediation iteration?
- We prefer a one-time invoice credit rather than an ongoing percentage discount. $6k aligns well with our procurement approval thresholds.
- If we can get final language this week we can route to legal 3/15 and sign by 3/19.

Appreciate the team's flexibility — Eric and I want to move fast on this.

Dana Morris
Director, Procurement
Brightline Labs

Forwarded attachment referenced: Brightline_SOW_v3.docx (see integration tasks, section 2.3)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: concierge + integration concession for Brightline pilot

Thanks all — reviewed with Finance and Legal. Approved on the following conditions:

1) ConciergePlus: included for the pilot only (40 hrs cap). RM names to be added; no SLA carryover post-pilot.
2) Custom connector: approved up to 8 dev-hours including testing and one remediation pass. Any additional work requires separate SOW.
3) Instead of a 10% usage discount, we will issue a one-time onboarding credit of $6,000 applied to the first invoice.
4) SOW must include the three acceptance KPIs Laura proposed; legal will insert language into the SLA amendment.

Sean — good to proceed. Once you get procurement's confirmation I'll ask Legal to finalize the DocuSign packet. Please ensure the SOW and SLA amendment reflect the caps clearly.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Approval note: Concession below delegated threshold for VP sign-off; finance reviewed, net present value assessed.
